---
title: "Unsupervised learning"
---

Explore patterns in data without using class labels to construct the representation or clusters.

## Principal component analysis

Principal component analysis (PCA) finds directions along which the data vary most. By projecting the data onto a few of these directions, we can explore a lower-dimensional view of its structure.

- [Explore how PCA chooses a direction](pca-explorer.qmd)
- [Work through the gas-sensor PCA notebook](01-pca-gas-sensor-array.ipynb)

## Density-based clustering

Density-based clustering groups observations that lie in dense regions of the data, while identifying isolated observations as noise. Explore how DBSCAN builds clusters without specifying their number in advance.

- [Step through DBSCAN on half moons](dbscan-explorer.qmd)
